# Variance indicator style catalog

<!-- Generated by scripts/build_styles.py. Edit the script, not this file. -->

![All styles](../assets/gallery.png)

Pick a style by name. Each preview shows the four states: up (+8.2%), down (-4.6%),
flat (0.0%) and blank (`--`, when no period is selected or the prior period has no data).
Colours flip for metrics where lower is better (`_HigherIsBetter = FALSE ()`).

Labels are generic (`vs last month`, `MoM`) and never name a month or year. Set
`_Label` to `""` to hide it, or to `QoQ` / `vs last quarter` / `YoY` / `vs last year`
for the other periods.

| Style | Looks like | Notes | Measure |
|---|---|---|---|
| **`arrow-simple`**<br>Simple arrow | ![arrow-simple](../assets/previews/arrow-simple.svg) | Bold block arrow and the percentage, nothing else.<br><sub>From: Style sheet #1</sub> | [arrow-simple.dax](styles/arrow-simple.dax) |
| **`arrow-suffix`**<br>Arrow after value | ![arrow-suffix](../assets/previews/arrow-suffix.svg) | Percentage first, thin arrow after it. Quiet, fits next to a big KPI number.<br><sub>From: Examples: 12.9% ↓, 80.9% ↑</sub> | [arrow-suffix.dax](styles/arrow-suffix.dax) |
| **`arrow-label`**<br>Arrow with label | ![arrow-label](../assets/previews/arrow-label.svg) | Block arrow, percentage, then a grey comparison label.<br><sub>From: Style sheet #3 (and #2 without the month)</sub> | [arrow-label.dax](styles/arrow-label.dax) |
| **`trend-label`**<br>Trend line with label | ![trend-label](../assets/previews/trend-label.svg) | Small trend-line icon, coloured percentage, grey label.<br><sub>From: Examples: ↗ 5% vs last month, ↗ 12.00% from June</sub> | [trend-label.dax](styles/trend-label.dax) |
| **`pill`**<br>Pill | ![pill](../assets/previews/pill.svg) | Soft coloured pill with arrow and percentage.<br><sub>From: Style sheet #4</sub> | [pill.dax](styles/pill.dax) |
| **`pill-label`**<br>Pill with label | ![pill-label](../assets/previews/pill-label.svg) | Soft pill holding the arrow, percentage and a short label.<br><sub>From: Style sheet #6 (and #5 without the month)</sub> | [pill-label.dax](styles/pill-label.dax) |
| **`pill-outline`**<br>Outline pill | ![pill-outline](../assets/previews/pill-outline.svg) | White pill with a coloured border, triangle and percentage.<br><sub>From: Style sheet #7</sub> | [pill-outline.dax](styles/pill-outline.dax) |
| **`trend-pill`**<br>Trend pill | ![trend-pill](../assets/previews/trend-pill.svg) | Percentage then a trend-line icon, inside a soft rounded box.<br><sub>From: Examples: 12.20% ↗, 38.64% ↗, 32.73% ↘</sub> | [trend-pill.dax](styles/trend-pill.dax) |

| **`label-chip`**<br>Label, chip after | ![label-chip](../assets/previews/label-chip.svg) | Grey label first, then the small chip. Good in a row of KPI cards.<br><sub>From: Example: vs Last Week +1.3% ↗</sub> | [label-chip.dax](styles/label-chip.dax) |

| **`triangle-tag`**<br>Triangle with tag | ![triangle-tag](../assets/previews/triangle-tag.svg) | Triangle, bold percentage and a short period tag (MoM, QoQ, YoY).<br><sub>From: Style sheet #8 and #9</sub> | [triangle-tag.dax](styles/triangle-tag.dax) |

| **`prefix`**<br>Tag prefix | ![prefix](../assets/previews/prefix.svg) | Period tag first (MoM:), then triangle and percentage.<br><sub>From: Style sheet #11</sub> | [prefix.dax](styles/prefix.dax) |
| **`text-only`**<br>Coloured text only | ![text-only](../assets/previews/text-only.svg) | No icon: coloured percentage and a period tag.<br><sub>From: Style sheet #14 and #19</sub> | [text-only.dax](styles/text-only.dax) |
